tool_description: Search through the most famous events in history. See more info at https://api-ninjas.com/api/historicalevents.
name: Historical Events by API-Ninjas
title: Historical Events by API-Ninjas

api_list.name: /v1/historicalevents
api_list.description: API Ninjas Historical Events API endpoint. Returns a list of up to 10 events that match the search parameters. At least one of the following parameters is required: text, year, month, day.

optional_parameters.name: text
optional_parameters.description: query text to search events by. Use keywords or short phrases for best match results.

optional_parameters.name: year
optional_parameters.description: 4-digit year (e.g. 1776). For BC/BCE years, use a negative integer (e.g. -351 for 351 BC).

optional_parameters.name: offset
optional_parameters.description: number of results to offset (for pagination).

test_endpoint.event: The Julian calendar takes effect as the civil calendar of the Roman Empire, establishing January 1 as the new date of the new year.
The Alemanni cross the frozen Rhine in large numbers, invading the Roman Empire.
Emperor Decius orders everyone in the Roman Empire (except Jews) to make sacrifices to the Roman gods.
Gaius Julius Caesar Octavianus is granted the title Augustus by the Roman Senate, marking the beginning of the Roman Empire.
Emperor Gratian elevates Flavius Theodosius at Sirmium to Augustus, and gives him authority over all the eastern provinces of the Roman Empire.
The Principality of Liechtenstein is created within the Holy Roman Empire.
Trajan succeeds his adoptive father Nerva as Roman emperor; under his rule the Roman Empire will reach its maximum extent.
Poland and the Holy Roman Empire conclude the Peace of Bautzen.
Constantius III becomes co-Emperor of the Western Roman Empire.
The death under mysterious circumstances of Tiberius Claudius Caesar Britannicus, heir to the Roman empire, on the eve of his coming of age clears the way for Nero to become Emperor.
